title: Previously assessed Venice Auxiliary Pumping Plant (VAPP) Environmental Impact Report SCH No. 2015111038, pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act…
text:
[Council File 26-0734-S1; CD 11]
Previously assessed Venice Auxiliary Pumping Plant (VAPP) Environmental Impact Report SCH No. 2015111038, pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines 15162 and 15164, and Addendums dated October 29, 2021 and June 2024; report from the Los Angeles City Planning Commission (LACPC); and an appeal filed by Kenya Lee, from the determination of the LACPC in 1) approving, pursuant to Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Chapter 1 Section 12.24 U.21, a Class 3 Conditional Use Permit to allow a pumping plant and a surface parking lot within the PF Zone; and 2) approving pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.4.2, a Project Compliance for a project located within the Ballona Lagoon West Subarea of the Venice Coastal Zone Specific Plan; for the construction of a two-story, 2,283 square-foot wastewater pumping plant (VAPP) to supplement the capacity of the existing Venice Pumping Plant (VPP) for conveyance of wastewater to the Hyperion Treatment Plant and the construction of a surface parking lot, providing three on-site parking spaces and seven off-site parking spaces; the Project includes an amendment to the certified Venice Local Coastal Program Land Use Plan map, to re-designate the subject site from Low Medium II Residential to Public Facility and a related text change; for the properties located at 128, 133 and 139 East Hurricane Street; 3813 and 3817 South Esplanade; and 3913 South Esplanade West; subject to Modified Conditions of Approval; and adoption of project findings.
Applicant: Department of Public Works (DPW) and LA Sanitation and Environment
Representative: DPW and Bureau of Engineering
Case No. CPC-2024-2010-GPA-ZC-CU3-SPPC-1A
Environmental SCH No. 2015111038; VAPP Project EIR
Related Case No. CPC-2024-2010-GPA-ZC-CU3-SPPC
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For:
Venice Neighborhood Council
TIME LIMIT FILE - OCTOBER 18, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - OCTOBER 16, 2026)
summary: Kenya Lee's appeal of City Planning's approval of a two-story, 2,283 square-foot wastewater pumping plant and surface parking lot in Venice, which also changes the site's land use designation from residential to public facility.
